messages:
Noah (Design): dropped a new idea for stackframe folding in request drilldown: https://rwd/fig/stackfold-v2.png. two modes: compact (collapse repetitive frames) vs expanded (full). main Qs: where to show folded count, and how to surface copy/share/export actions for the trace
Priya (Product): compact first, expand on demand. show a small "+3 frames" affordance inline that expands in place. for exports, separate 'Share link' (permalink) from 'Download traces' (csv/jsonl) so users don't confuse them
Diego (Eng-runtime): implementing inline "+N frames" is cheap. please add data-attr with span range so we can lazy-fetch frames on expand. copy correlation id should be an explicit inline text button (label: 'Copy trace id') not just an icon for clarity
Jin (Eng-sre): for oncall flows we often paste trace id into ops channel. inline copy is great. also fav: show a small chevron to jump to related spans by correlation id. Export defaults should be CSV (summary) and JSONL (full with stack frames). include header versioning like `export_v=2`
Ava (Accessibility): accessibility notes: folded indicator must be keyboard-focusable and announce like "3 stack frames collapsed, press enter to expand". color alone can't indicate folded/expanded state; use aria-expanded on the control. for the copy button: aria-label="Copy correlation ID to clipboard" and toast must be role=status with aria-live=polite
Noah (Design): UX copy adjustments: tooltip text -> 'Copy trace id' (short) and export menu -> 'Download traces' with subitems 'CSV (summary)' and 'JSONL (full)'. show redaction note in export modal: 'PII redaction enabled by default' with an advanced toggle
Diego (Eng-runtime): agreed on redaction default. we'll run a redaction pass to scrub emails and ip-like tokens. advanced download will require an org-level permission `exports:full` and an audit log entry
Priya (Product): add a small inline badge next to exported filename with `export_v=2` and format. also request we standardize CSV columns: `trace_id,span_id,start_ms,duration_ms,service,error`, and include `tags` as json-string column if present
Jin (Eng-sre): for perf, lazy fetch of folded frames should debounce 200ms and cache per-user for 5 minutes. also add telemetry events: `fold_expand`, `copy_trace_id`, `export_initiated`
Ava (Accessibility): one more: ensure focus lands on the first expanded frame after keyboard expand. that helps screen-reader users navigate content change
Noah (Design): i'll push updated frames with focus states and the export modal copy. pinging @Priya for final wording sign-off. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: Preview available at https://rwd/deploys/stackfold-v2-preview (expires in 48h)
